summary: Nanobiotix S.A. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) on September 14, 2026, attaching a press release disclosing complete full-cohort Phase 1 results for JNJ-1900 (NBTXR3) in inoperable, locoregionally recurrent NSCLC amenable to re-irradiation. All 24 patients completed treatment with no dose-limiting toxicities and no Grade 3+ related adverse events. One-year locoregional control was 79%, local progression-free survival 61%, and overall survival 70%. Data were presented at the IASLC 2026 WCLC in Seoul. This is a routine clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation.
